description.value: A fully automated MRI volumetry study measured regional gray matter volumes and longitudinal atrophy progression in clinically diagnosed FTLD patients and age-matched healthy controls, including bvFTLD, PNFA, and SemD subgroups.

spans.text: A novel method of automated MRI volumetry was used to study regional atrophy and disease progression in repeated MRI measurements of patients with frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD).
